deploymentGuide.title: DNS Worker Setup & Deployment Guide
deploymentGuide.subtitle: Your instance is not fully configured yet. Please complete the setup below to start using DNS Worker.
deploymentGuide.stepDbDesc: Create a D1 database and bind it to your worker. In your terminal, run:
deploymentGuide.stepDbDesc2: Copy the output D1 database details and paste them into your wrangler.toml under [[d1_databases]]:
deploymentGuide.stepDbDashDesc:
1. Go to Cloudflare Dashboard -> Workers & Pages -> D1. Click "Create Database" and name it 'dns_worker_db'.
2. Go to your Worker -> Settings -> Variables -> D1 Database Bindings -> Add Binding.
3. Set Binding name to 'DB', and select 'dns_worker_db' as D1 database. Click Save.
4. Go to your D1 database -> Console, copy and execute the SQL tables schema script from the migrations folder to set up database structure.
deploymentGuide.stepJwtDesc: DNS Worker requires a JWT secret for signing session tokens and API security. Configure it as a Cloudflare Secret:
deploymentGuide.stepJwtDashDesc:
1. Go to your Worker -> Settings -> Variables -> Environment Variables -> Add Variable.
2. Set Name to 'JWT_SECRET', choose type 'Secret', and enter a secure random string (e.g. 64 hex characters) as Value.
3. Save and Deploy.
deploymentGuide.stepDeployDesc: Run the deploy command to compile frontend, apply D1 database schema migrations automatically, and publish configurations live:
deploymentGuide.stepDeployDashDesc: If you completed all configurations via the Cloudflare Dashboard, go to your Worker's Deployments tab, click 'Deploy' or 'Re-deploy' to publish the latest configurations.
deploymentGuide.jwtGeneratorDesc: Use this cryptographically secure key generator to generate a random 64-character alphanumeric secret for your env.JWT_SECRET.
